name: Recentralization Drift
definition: A system designed to distribute authority concentrates it again through tooling, delegation, capital, or expertise asymmetry.
trigger_conditions: A small number of operators run most infrastructure or most agents
Delegation is permitted and defaults are sticky
Participation cost rises with system maturity

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: concentration of institution specific information in few hands

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F029 Recentralization Drift. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F029
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
